name: 薅羊毛
author: Ben
summary: Matches your shopping list and AI tools to grocery specials, quota resets, and checkout codes, staying quiet otherwise.
starterPrompt: Learn my regular shopping list and AI tools, then alert me only when a matching deal or quota reset appears.
usageNote: Check prices, terms, expiry dates, and regional availability before acting. The bot does not make payments or create accounts.
